nom: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Eye Serum for Wrinkles and Crow's Feet

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or eczema-prone under-eye skin report the serum keeps the area more hydrated and comfortable through the day, though at least one still sees dryness and crepiness return by evening; one severe negative report describes the product itself leaving under-eye skin drier and saggier than before.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several report no irritation and count this among the gentler options they have tried, while others report stinging on application, in some cases severe enough to stop use.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention their age skew mature, from the upper 30s to 70, with mixed results: several in their 50s and 60s report firmer, plumper, less crepey skin with sustained use, while others, including a 70-year-old and a 48-year-old comparing it to a discontinued product, report no visible effect or increased crepiness.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, crow's feet, and firmer, plumper under-eye skin after a few days to several weeks of consistent use, with several of the most positive results coming from reviewers in their 50s and 60s. A substantial minority, however, report no visible change, and some, including a 70-year-old and a 48-year-old comparing it to a discontinued product, report the under-eye area looking more lined, crepey, or aged after use; one review describes sagging and deeper wrinkles she considers worse than before starting.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including some with naturally dry or eczema-prone under-eye skin, report the serum keeps the area hydrated, smoother, and less crepey through the day. A minority report the opposite: skin that became drier, crepey, or saggy while using it, in one case severely so.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation, including several who describe their own skin as sensitive. A recurring minority, however, report burning, stinging, redness, scaliness, or swelling after application, ranging from mild stinging that stopped with less frequent use to reactions serious enough that reviewers stopped using the product entirely; one review describes facial swelling and an itchy throat consistent with an allergic reaction.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup without pilling
Pills or creases makeup for some users
Dropper can be imprecise or break

extraits.titre: Did the opposite of what it claims
extraits.texte: I use and love many of The Ordinary products and didn't think this one would be any different. I had fine lines and slight dark circles under my eyes so thought this would help to minimise them but what it's actually done is made things so much worse. I now have dry, saggy, wrinkly skin under my eye and large, dark bags. The skin is also now incredibly sensitive and stings all the time, even when I'm not using any products. I look like I've aged at least 10 years. I've stopped using this product and I really hope the damage is not permanent as I hate the way I now look. - from fine lines to deep, saggy wrinkles under my eyes. If anyone else has experienced anything similar, is this a permanent change?

Gifted during a Black Friday deal, I was excited to use this eye serum into my skincare routine, expecting the usual positive results I've come to associate with The Ordinary. Unfortunately, the morning after my first use, I woke up to a severely swollen face, to the extent that opening my eyes was a struggle. Initially thought this reaction to a possible food allergy, I gave my body two weeks to recover before attempting to use the serum again. Regrettably, the second application resulted in a similarly severe reaction, confirming my suspicions that this specific product was the culprit. Alongside the swelling, I also experienced an itchy throat, a symptom that was both unexpected and concerning.
I have been using for approximately 45 days. It just isn't working. I have to use several other products for the bags and lines. I am 70. It may work for younger skin, but not mine

I'm 40 and dealing with dry skin on my eyes to the point of dermatitis or eczema. I'm paying $150 for eye creams that don't work. I added this and surprisingly it works better than anything else. It's also fungal acne safe so I don't have to worry about it. I still am searching for a cream to go on top to make it last longer but on its own, its lasting longer than my creams, but still doesn't last 8+ hours. I have crepey drooping lids by the end of the day still but def less uncomfortable now.

extraits.titre: Works well with my sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I received this item with my order as part of a Black Friday special. I had been looking for an under eye treatments to help with dark circles and fine lines, but have been weary to try products due to my sensitive skin. I have been using this product in the morning and evenings for about 2 weeks now. I have seen reduction in my dark circles and more smoothness than before. I use it in addition to the cleanser, hyaluronic acid serum, and daily moisterizer. I have not had any other stinging or rawness that others have posted about. Even though the serum is small, you only need to use a very small amount so I think it will last a while!

I've been using this eye serum for 4 years now and is the best purchase I've ever made. I'm 60 and the skin around ny eyes looks plump, healthy and younger for my age. I use it day and night right after washing my face and before any serum or cream. Love love love 👌

This product works. I have both under eye serums and this one is by far the best. I can now write a legitimate review after so much use that this eye serum actually works. It shouldn't dry out or burn it's just an oily base. It takes away my dark circles I don't have puffy under eyes only dark circles. I have very sensitive skin that easily breaks out as well this and the product with the pink color are by far the best on here and I've used many.
